name: Dimeglow
subtitle: Log spending in one sentence
shortDescription: Type "lunch 12 with Sam" and you are done. See today, this week and this month on your Lock Screen.
longDescription:
You already know roughly what you spent today. Dimeglow makes it a number you can see.

### Log It in a Sentence
Type what you bought: "coffee 4.50", "uber 23.40 yesterday", "lunch 12 with Sam". Dimeglow reads the amount, the date and a category, and shows what it understood before you save. Fix a category once and it remembers your way of naming things. That learning happens on your phone.

### A Glance, Not a Spreadsheet
A glowing ring shows how much is left this week. Three tiles show today, this week and this month. Add a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget and the answer is there before you unlock anything.

### Gentle Limits
Set a monthly limit, a weekly one, or limits for single categories. Nothing locks and nothing scolds. If you drift past a limit, the app simply says so and offers a fresh week.

### Finds Your Repeating Payments
Subscriptions and steady bills are spotted from your own entries. Confirm one and it shows up under "Coming up", and in the month-end estimate. The estimate is built from your last four weeks and only appears once you have enough history.

### Bring in Your Bank's Export
Download a CSV from your bank and import it. Dimeglow reads the columns on your phone, skips money coming in, and switches off anything you already logged. No bank login, no upload.

### Travel with Your Own Rates
Log in euros, pounds or yen and type the exchange rates yourself, so totals match what your card really charged.

### See Where It Goes
Day-by-day bars, a category ring, habits that add up, and your usual week.

### Private By Design
No account. No cloud. No bank link. Your purchases live in one file on your device. Erase them any time.
